summary: Bind each VM start admission to its exact operation and epoch, then reconcile terminal start outcomes from durable Core journals and fresh native state without clearing uncertain execution.

guide.reason: Explains confirmed preflight refusal versus uncertain automatic-start outcome, and why a shut-off observation or successful emergency stop does not by itself settle an uncertain master reservation; native verification remains pending.

api.reason: Existing authenticated Core peer start/settlement requests bind operation ID and epoch; owner inventory carries exact definitive failed-start journal identities. Matching development Core versions are required. Controller displays adopted state and synthetic task outcomes.

roadmap.reason: Corrects current Core recovery behavior without closing or expanding a milestone.

state.record: Pool master pool-vms.json pending_start_operation_id and existing epoch, replicated through signed authority records; executing Core managed operation journals record automatic start_outcome at the native-dispatch boundary.
state.reason: A fresh Controller adopts the resulting VM state and outcomes through host inventory. Controller stores no pool start authority.

verification.method: The disposable native r8 run reproduced a memory-preflight failure that left the master at starting. Native owner full vmhost and race tests passed (9.870s and 15.405s); final agent owner full and race tests passed (15.088s and 56.441s).
